script_text: Stop, Aries — Saturn just locked into your sign, and it's rewriting your future. Saturn is settling into the 1st House near 5° Aries, a slow transit that will test your fire sign resilience and reshape your identity through 2029. Meanwhile, the Virgo Sun forms a tense square to your ruling planet Mars, creating real friction between ambition and obligation. In your 7th House of Partnerships, Venus in Libra steers you toward honesty over charm — if taken, watch for unspoken resentments surfacing. If single, maturity and steadiness are your most magnetic qualities right now. Jupiter in Taurus activates your 10th House of Career, signaling a professional opportunity tied to property or finance this week. Avoid signing contracts before September 20th — your 6th House of Health needs real rest, not more hustle. Follow for tomorrow's reading, subscribe so you don't miss Saturn's three-year sweep through Aries.
